reviews.text: Started taking my girl here and we’ve been loving it. It’s so nice being on a grooming schedule and  Demetrius the groomer is very talented and creative. Highly recommend if you want ur dog to be the most stylish on the block

I booked for a full dash on my Standard Goldendoodle & told the groomer to make her look cute!! The salon manager Demetrice did an amazing job! The bather Nyla is always so welcoming & visibly excited to see my dog!! I got to meet the owner Mr.Lloyd who shared the details of the membership plan and perks.

The value and service I’ve received is superior, I’ve been going to them 8 years and will recommend to all dog parents. They bathe & condition to keep her fur & skin clean & hydrated, her ears get dirty so quickly so they pay attention to that, they grind her nails instead of clipping so they don’t split or crack, brush her teeth and do her anal glands so that she’s not irritated from the build up and scooting across the floor to relieve the itching!

They care about the health, wellness & comfort of your pet, not just about doing numbers.
Demetrius did a fantastic job for Chanel I would recommend puppy haberdashery to anyone with a dog

I had an amazing experience at Puppy Haberdashery Hyde Park! I brought my Yorkie, Major, in for a full-service grooming, and they exceeded my expectations. The staff was welcoming, professional, and treated Major with so much care from the moment we walked in.

When I picked him up, he looked absolutely handsome, smelled incredible, and his haircut was exactly what I wanted. You can tell they genuinely care about the pets they work with and pay close attention to every detail.

If you’re looking for a groomer that provides excellent customer service and leaves your dog looking their absolute best, I highly recommend Puppy Haberdashery Hyde Park. Major and I will definitely be back. Thank you for taking such great care of my little guy!

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at The Haberdasher. I took my dog in for grooming, yesterday and when my husband picked her up, we discovered that she had been cut during the grooming process. As a pet owner, seeing your dog come home injured is upsetting and unacceptable.

What was even more concerning was the response from management. When I spoke with the store manager , there was very little empathy or concern shown for my dog’s injury. The situation was handled in a very nonchalant manner I feel like  and I was informed that they would not cover any veterinary expenses if treatment became necessary.

Accidents can happen, and I understand that no groomer is perfect. However, how a business responds when something goes wrong says a lot about their professionalism and customer service. I expected accountability, concern for my pet’s well-being, and a willingness to make the situation right. Unfortunately, I received none of those things.

Based on this experience, I cannot recommend The Haberdasher to other pet owners. I encourage anyone considering their services to ask how grooming injuries are handled before leaving their beloved pet in their care.

While walking my dog, I was approached by a young man who stopped me and stated, "Come get your dog some color."  My dog is black so I was confused.  Then I looked up and saw he came out of Puppy Haberdashery.  I usually groom my dog myself, but I took this as a sign to have her complete a full service and learn more about coloring.  I made an appointment and secured my deposit.  Unfortunately, my appointment had to be rescheduled, due to a plumbing issue, but Puppy Haberdashery was very professional in their rescheduling approach.  I am impressed with the level of service here and would recommend to all dog owners that have "timid" fur babies.  Now time to book a coloring appointment.
Love his work & my girl so cute
From the minute we walked in we were greeted and Joy loved the groomers! They took great care of my baby Joy! I will definitely be back!
Demetrius is a very talented and artistic groomer always welcoming and courteous. Consideration to dogs specific needs along with Nylia who also is very accommodating.
Aweosmeeeeeeee Serviceeee and very Professional and Nice Staff. Highly Recommend
My fur baby has been going going here for about 2yrs. I love the service and the professionalism of the staff.

Demetrius.did a excellent job on my fur baby  he was extremely patient with my fur baby. I got her colored also it came out Beautiful.
They did an amazing job with my fur baby CoCo! The groomers were efficient, talented, and reasonably priced. I highly recommend this business!
Always do a great job with my fur baby! And Demetrius is great he knows his stuff!
Great service and my dog always leave her grooming session looking like a diva
Great Job Always
Nyla and Mr Dimitrius was simply Awesome w Excellent customer service.  We Love Yall for Taking care of our Puppy Boy Ohso💚 …
Great black owned grooming salon. My pup always comes out looking amazing!!!
Demetrius is such an angel and always takes good care of my baby! Clean, smells good and great cut!

I will NEVER take my fur baby to the Hyde Park Puppy  Haberdashery again. I arrived at 7:50 for my 8:00 appointment on Friday, July 18. I was told by Demetrius 2 1/2 hours. Another person was present with their dog, and I paid attention to the breed as I left. Waiting for the text letting me know she'll be ready within 30 minutes, I  decided to head that way at 11:00. When I went inside at 11:20 I gave my dog's name. I was told the price so I paid and took a seat. Two other patrons were present, and their dogs came out before mine. I sat patiently. I then asked about my dog and was told she wasn't ready! I was told she would be ready in 30 minutes (noon). She wasn't ready until 12:35! Almost five hours! I told the groomer, Demetrius, that I was very unhappy with today's service.  I pointed out that the two dogs that came out before my dog weren't there when I  dropped off my dog, so how could they both be ready before mine if I had the first appointment.  He said that the one dog was there before me, but it wasn't the same breed I saw when I  left. This was a huge poodle! I asked how many 8:00 appointments he took, and he said only the two. I once again expressed how I didn't understand how two other dogs that he groomed would be ready before mine and how it was almost 5 hours when I  was told 2 1/2! Same lie!
Monday, 9/22/25 was the final straw! My dog had a 9:00 appointment and was told again by Demetrius, 2 1/2 hours.  At 11:45, my husband headed back. At 12:18, my husband said he was told she was matted, which was impossible as I thoroughly brushed her the night before!  I asked him to ask where she was supposed to be matted, and he was told  that her ears, stomach, and muzzle were matted and that it would be $35 extra! Again, it was impossible as I brushed her the night before. Mind you, she has a good coat,  a good grade of hair, and her stomach fur lies flat! At 12:45, she was still on the table! Not only did Demetrius from Hyde Park Puppy Haberdashery lie to me as to what time he would be finished, they lie about her being matted charging an extra $35, but worse of all,  they made her face look like a rat!  I gave them three pictures of how I wanted her cut. How did they confuse my wishes? Her ears are cut too short, and her muzzle is just ugly... maybe that's why he lied and said she was matted to cover up the poor grooming!

I am a new dog owner. My dog is sometimes a little difficult but The puppy haberdashery gets my girl so fresh and clean. She loves going there and I love the level of professionalism and service I receive. I have even purchased a membership to keep her clean and fresh between grooming. So happy to
Have found Demetrius and the puppy haberdashery! Take your dog to get dashed!
They did so good. Demetrce did so good and it was his birthday.

Puppy Haberdashery did an amazing job with my golden doodle, Bryson! The staff was warm, professional, and clearly experienced with doodle coats. Bryson came out looking adorable—clean, fluffy, and happy. I loved the personal touches and how well they cared for him. Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality grooming with heart!

I’ve been a loyal customer of Puppy Haberdashery Hyde Park for nearly two years. In the beginning, I was truly happy with the service—my puppy’s first grooming experience was amazing. The original groomers, Brittney and Brittany, were professional, thorough, and clearly cared about the quality of their work.

Unfortunately, over time, I noticed a decline in service. Each visit started to feel less consistent, and my puppy would sometimes come back with issues like cuts near her nipples or areas where bonding glue had to be used. Despite paying for a full groom, I’d still find matted patches when I combed her at home. It felt like the extra care and attention to detail had disappeared.

I believe Demetrice, the current groomer, may be rushing through appointments or skipping important steps. It’s disappointing, especially when I’m being charged an additional $45 and not seeing the value in the work.

It saddens me to say that my most recent experience was not great. I truly miss the level of care Brittney and Brittany brought to the Hyde Park location. I hope to see that standard of service return in the future.
Demetrius is great!!!! I love them.
I love 79th Hamlin location too

I cannot recommend Puppy Haberdashery Groom Services enough! From start to finish, the experience was outstanding. Demetrius did a wonderful job grooming my pet Nike — he was incredibly patient, attentive, and truly listened to all of my requests. Nike looked absolutely perfect after his session, and it’s clear that Demetrius puts real care and skill into his work. It’s rare to find someone who treats your pet with such kindness and professionalism. I will definitely be coming back and recommending Puppy Haberdashery to everyone I know!
I truly enjoyed my first service, but my second was a disaster. They truly don’t care for the animals, they are just a money hungry spot. Will never return here .

My furbaby and I LOVE and are so grateful for Puppy Haberdashery! When I dropped her off for her very first grooming as a puppy, I was so nervous to hand her off to someone else and leave her for a couple of hours. However, I picked up a happy, and beautifully cut and styled puppy,  and received the memento of a lock of her baby hair! That was over a year and a half ago, and the staff is still just as warm, caring, and kind to me and my dog! They listen to your concerns and are considerate with your requests. I never have to worry about Coco because she’s in great hands with Demetris and Jasmine! They are both so patient and sweet with my little ball of energy, and she always comes back to me excited and playful, letting me know that she was well cared for by them. The team is very skilled and precise in their cleaning, cutting, and styling and they even offer LOTS of artistry with color and accessaries! Whether you want your pet to have routine maintenance or a fun and glam new look, give Ms. Yahdna a call (or book online) and let the team at Puppy Haberdashery get you #Dashed

I love this place. We found our groomer with Demetrius and the young lady that works there is amazing. This was a great, first time experience and Charlie will be around all the time. Haircut was perfect. I recommend selecting the fully Dash service and I really love the dog cologne and hankerchief ❤️ my wife was extremely happy.

I've brought my dog here at least 4 times, but recently my experience was not the best and we won't be back.

Brought my dog in late (which I take accountability for) ,but the visit took 3 hours which is very unusual. I stopped by after an hour and my dog wasn't ready and was told to come back (which should've been a clue) after coming back I noticed he had red stains on the top of his head and I asked the groomer if it was dye and the groomer asked if i wanted to cut it out and I said no its fine.

Fast forward 30 minutes later after leaving I noticed red staining on my hand after getting my dog out of his kennel and  quickly realized it was blood and it was coming from his ear from a cut. Which seems that the visit took longer than expected, because they were trying to cover up the bleeding or stop it.

I reached out to puppy haberdashery 3 times and have not received any apologies or an explanation and I reached out November 30th. This is extremely terrible for business practice.

Please proceed and tread with extreme caution if you choose to patronize this business and make sure you're checking your pup throughly.
My pup Grayson’s first grooming with Puppy Haberdashery was top notch! Demetrius took great care of my baby and had him looking soooo handsome!🥰🐶 …

Junie just loves PH! We’ve been going since 2019 and have not been anywhere since. Junie can be hard to deal with since she flaps on the floor every time she is getting groomed but Lloyd and his team do a great job!

My groomer was Demetrius and he set the captives free.   My baby Yorkie came loaded with hair and as cute as she is she was looking motley. But let me tell you when I picked her up she was picture perfect. My groomer gave her a nose ring a perfect cut and she was almost unrecognizable  she was beautiful. Thank you puppy  haberdasery in Hyde park.  Momma Hawk and Mercedes Joi are happy  campers
They took such great care of my handsome boys! One of my boys are very anxious and they did such a great job being patient with him! I am looking forward to returning.
My shih tzu, Cupcake loves to come to Puppy Haberdashery to get pampered. The groomer, Demetrice always provides excellent service! Highly recommend! :)
Quick service,  love the staff, and Demetrice Rock!

Demetrice does a great job!
